architecture.name: Input
architecture.detail: Grayscale mouth region, 88x88 px, 25 fps. Visual only: audio is never read.

architecture.name: Visual frontend
architecture.detail: Conv3d 1->64 (kernel 5x7x7, stride 1x2x2) + BN + SiLU + MaxPool3d, then a ResNet-18 applied per frame with global average pooling -> 512-d

architecture.name: Conformer encoder
architecture.detail: 12 blocks, d=768, 12 heads, FFN 3072, depthwise conv kernel 31

architecture.name: CTC head
architecture.detail: Linear 768 -> 5049 tokens; weight 0.1 in loss and in decoding

architecture.name: Beam search
architecture.detail: Joint CTC/attention, beam 40, no external language model
